implementation_summary: Integration tests start a RunnerServer with the production route table on temp data folders (ports 3841-3845) and call it over HTTP: persistence across restart (one and two versions), local-files-only with no Google host, Shortlist round trip, delete leaving no file, beta plus access key leaving only Shared Links public, and a Helper signed in with a locally signed token over a fake key download (list, open, 404, 403, grant removal). A Chromium test opens a stored preview via the API and via its Shared Link, clicks a menu link and an in-page link with outbound requests intercepted, and checks the page runs no script.

tests_executed.name: audit persistence and access integration tests
type check of the new files
tests_executed.output_excerpt: no errors reported for the two new files

tests_proposed: Helper with an edit grant over HTTP: PUT shortlist succeeds, export row allowed, owner rows still 403
Stored preview with two style elements: assert both are hashed in the CSP header in the browser
Restart with an expired Helper cookie and with a cookie from another runner instance (random per-instance key) is refused
Cloud store backend (AUDIT_STORE_BUCKET) with a fake fetch: same persistence and delete assertions
risks: The runner package has no Playwright dependency; the browser test resolves it from packages/core via createRequire and takes types from ../../core/node_modules/playwright. Adding it to the runner is a P2 change needing a planned task.
Both new files start a runner (and the browser one launches Chromium) but are not in BROWSER_TESTS in vitest.workspace.ts (outside my ownership), so they run in the 'unit' project.
On a beta copy, creating a Shared Link answers 403 ERR_BETA even with the access key, so the test creates the link on a non-beta runner, restarts the same folder as beta, and checks /s/:linkId there.
After a Helper grant is removed, the Helper's list request answers 403 ERR_FORBIDDEN (not 401), because the session cookie is still valid and holds no grants.
Owner rows refused by the access-key gate answer 401 without a code field (only the message mentions the access key); view rows refused by the route table carry ERR_ACCESS_KEY.
The no-Google-host check spies on globalThis.fetch and a fetch injected into selectAuditStoreBackend; a call through another transport (raw http or https) would not be seen.
handoff: Both checks (CHK-QA-600-INTEGRATION and CHK-QA-600-BROWSER) can be re-run as given in the packet. Ports used: 3841-3845. Core was built first with pnpm --filter @qa/types --filter @qa/checkers --filter @qa/core run build.
